description: Add a button on /rules (or /settings) that re-runs apply_rules against every uncategorized transaction, or optionally every transaction. Biggest daily-use gap: when a new rule is created today, it only applies to future syncs. Historical uncategorized rows stay uncategorized until hand-fixed. Scope decision: default to uncategorized-only to avoid overwriting user-set categories; add a 'force overwrite' option if needed.
title: Re-apply all rules to existing transactions
